expectedIssues: Delivery fee text overlaps the delivery time text
reportedIssues: In the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card the metadata line renders two overlapping strings: '25–35 min' and '€0 delivery' are drawn on top of each other ('25–3⁠5⁠0⁠rd⁠elivery'), making both unreadable before the '• Ramen' tag.

The favourite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different styles: the first has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, the second has a dark/translucent circle with a white heart.

The third item in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated mid-title ('Trattoria Piccol') at the screen edge, and the category chip row is similarly clipped ('Healthy' followed by a partially visible chip), giving the impression of cut-off content rather than a scrollable list.
The second 'Popular right now' card is cut off hard by the bottom navigation bar with no bottom padding, so its title and rating are entirely hidden.
Secondary metadata such as '€0.90 delivery' and the 'DELIVER TO' label are light grey on white, likely below the 4.5:1 contrast requirement.
